MacOS queue and execution time under org contention (5 macOS job limit) amplify the deterministic work nonlinearly; a single run queued 17.5m then executed 30.45m, while a comparable skipped-mutation run queued 27.57m

Seven linked remediation tickets target the named slow tests and xdist cache defects while preserving CI coverage, worker topology, and accepted contracts (N=3000 events, left-changeful-mamba, suave-constant-cow)
